ZaneH/piano-trainer
https://github.com/ZaneH/piano-trainer
MIT, Copyright © 2022 Zane Helton

Upstream is a React + Tauri desktop app. It loads MIDI soundfonts from
a CDN via soundfont-player, talks to a keyboard over Web MIDI, and
persists settings in a native store. None of that ships here.

This port is a classic-script rewrite of the trainer loop: scales,
triads, seventh chords, circle of fifths, and a short quiz. Notes
play from a local piano bank synthesized in this tab (the CDN
soundfont stays behind). MIDI is optional if the browser offers it.
Home-row keys play the same notes as tapping the on-screen keyboard.
Progress (last key, mode, quiz score, finished rounds) stays in the
file.

What was kept: major / natural-minor / melodic-minor / harmonic-minor
scale shapes, triads and sevenths built on scale degrees, fifths
around the circle, the quiz of keys and fifths (plus chord names).

What stays behind: React, Tauri, Sentry, i18n packs, CRA, and remote
soundfont files.
